                    "review_classification": str(
                        state.get("classification", "")
                    ),
                    "review_reason_code": str(state.get("reason_code", "")),
                    "review_message": str(state.get("review_message", "")),
                    "review_candidate_amount_pln": state.get(
                        "candidate_amount_pln"
                    ),
                    "review_candidate_source_code": str(
                        state.get("candidate_source_code", "")
                    ),
                    "reviewed_on": str(state.get("reviewed_on", "")),
                }
            )
"""
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "_apply_reviewed_gap_states(" not in text:
        if marker not in text:
            raise RuntimeError("configuration shortlist render marker missing")
        path.write_text(text.replace(marker, function + marker, 1), encoding="utf-8")
    replace_once(
        path,
        "            _apply_supplemental_model_media(catalog, selected_repository)\n"
        "            write_atomic(arguments.html, render_html(catalog))\n",
        "            _apply_supplemental_model_media(catalog, selected_repository)\n"
        "            _apply_reviewed_gap_states(catalog, selected_repository)\n"
        "            write_atomic(arguments.html, render_html(catalog))\n",
    )


def patch_selection_js() -> None:
    path = ROOT / "tools/reporting/configuration_shortlist_selection.js"
    replace_once(
        path,
        '    if (status === "not_available") return "niedostępne";\n'
        '    if (status === "unknown") return "status nieustalony";\n',
        '    if (status === "not_available") return "niedostępne";\n'
        '    if (status === "not_applicable") return "nie dotyczy";\n'
        '    if (status === "unknown") return "status nieustalony";\n',
    )
    replace_once(
        path,
        '    if (date) parts.push(`obserwacja: ${date}`);\n'
        '    return parts.join("; ");\n',
        '    if (date) parts.push(`obserwacja: ${date}`);\n'
        '    const review = String(state.review_message || "").trim();\n'
        '    if (review) parts.push(review);\n'
        '    return parts.join("; ");\n',
    )


def patch_pricing_js() -> None:
    path = ROOT / "tools/reporting/configuration_shortlist_v12_pricing.js"
    replace_once(
        path,
        '      source_code: String(component.source_code || ""),\n'
        '      equipment_codes: unique(component.equipment_codes || [])\n',
        '      source_code: String(component.source_code || ""),\n'
        '      review_classification: String(component.review_classification || ""),\n'
        '      review_reason_code: String(component.review_reason_code || ""),\n'
        '      review_message: String(component.review_message || ""),\n'
        '      review_candidate_amount_pln: component.review_candidate_amount_pln ?? null,\n'
        '      review_candidate_source_code: String(component.review_candidate_source_code || ""),\n'
        '      equipment_codes: unique(component.equipment_codes || [])\n',
    )
    replace_once(
        path,
        '          amount: null, currency_code: currencyCode, price_date: "", source_code: "",\n'
        '          equipment_codes: [code]\n',
        '          amount: null, currency_code: currencyCode, price_date: "", source_code: "",\n'
        '          review_classification: "", review_reason_code: "", review_message: "",\n'
        '          review_candidate_amount_pln: null, review_candidate_source_code: "",\n'
        '          equipment_codes: [code]\n',
    )
    replace_once(
        path,
        '          kind: component.kind,\n'
        '          amount: component.amount\n',
        '          kind: component.kind,\n'
        '          amount: component.amount,\n'
        '          review_classification: component.review_classification,\n'
        '          review_message: component.review_message\n',
    )
    helper_marker = "\n  function selectedEquipmentStatus(item) {\n"
    helper = r"""

  function unknownComponentStatus(component) {
    const reviewed = String(component.review_message || "").trim();
    if (reviewed) return reviewed;
    return component.source_code
      ? "cena niepodana w źródle"
      : "brak powiązania z cennikiem";
  }
"""
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "function unknownComponentStatus(" not in text:
        if helper_marker not in text:
            raise RuntimeError("pricing helper marker missing")
        path.write_text(text.replace(helper_marker, helper + helper_marker, 1), encoding="utf-8")
    replace_once(
        path,
        '        const price = component.amount === null ? "cena niepodana w źródle" : "dopłata ujęta powyżej";\n',
        '        const price = component.amount === null ? unknownComponentStatus(component) : "dopłata ujęta powyżej";\n',
    )
    replace_once(
        path,
        '        const status = component.source_code\n'
        '          ? "cena niepodana w źródle"\n'
        '          : "brak powiązania z cennikiem";\n',
        '        const status = unknownComponentStatus(component);\n',
    )
    replace_once(
        path,
        '    selectedEquipmentStatus, selectedEquipmentMarkup\n',
        '    selectedEquipmentStatus, selectedEquipmentMarkup,\n'
        '    unknownComponentStatus\n',
    )


def write_tests() -> None:
    path = ROOT / "tests/test_reviewed_gap_state_materialization_20260802.py"
    path.write_text(
        r"""from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import unittest
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def rows(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle))


def payload(path: Path) -> dict:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


class ReviewedGapStateMaterializationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_two_exact_spring_prices_are_materialized(self) -> None:
        selected = {
            (row["commercial_item_code"], row["configuration_code"]): row
            for row in rows(ROOT / "data/master/commercial_item_configurations.csv")
            if row["commercial_item_code"] in {
                "spring_city_package",
                "spring_power_package",
            }
            and row["configuration_code"] == "spring_extreme_electric100_automatic"
        }
        self.assertEqual(
            {key: row["amount"] for key, row in selected.items()},
            {
                ("spring_city_package", "spring_extreme_electric100_automatic"): "1800",
                ("spring_power_package", "spring_extreme_electric100_automatic"): "3000",
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            {row["source_code"] for row in selected.values()},
            {"src_pl_spring_official_configurator_20260731"},
        )
        self.assertEqual({row["price_date"] for row in selected.values()}, {"2026-07-31"})

    def test_materialization_closes_all_reviewed_presentation_states(self) -> None:
        report = payload(
            ROOT / "data/reporting/reviewed_gap_state_materialization.json"
        )
        self.assertEqual(report["summary"]["imported_price_rows"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(report["summary"]["comparison_terminal_states"], 22)
        self.assertEqual(report["summary"]["price_terminal_states"], 27)
        classifications = Counter(
            item["classification"]
            for item in [*report["comparison_states"], *report["price_states"]]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            classifications,
            Counter(
                {
                    "source-not-stated": 27,
                    "context-unmodeled": 20,
                    "source-conflict": 2,
                }
            ),
        )

    def test_browser_catalog_receives_reviewed_terminal_states(self) -> None:
        import sys
